title: Liar's Dice (Perudo): hidden dice + bidding + bluffing
description: Each player rolls dice hidden behind a cup. Players bid on total count of a face value across ALL players' dice. Each bid must raise quantity or face value. Challenge (dudo) reveals all dice — if bid was wrong, bidder loses a die; if correct, challenger loses a die. Last player with dice wins. Validates: imperfect information (per-player hidden dice), simultaneous reveal on challenge, player elimination, bidding as structured action, hidden state vault for dice values. Great complement to poker for hidden-info mechanics.
close_reason: Liar's Dice playable with 23 tests. Covers: hidden per-player dice, escalating bids (quantity or face), challenge resolution with full reveal, correct/incorrect bid detection, die forfeiture, multi-round elimination, loser-starts-next, game end on elimination. Imperfect information complement to poker.
